{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0156","text":"Sorensen Contract Kickoff!!! 🎉
Thursday, March 14 · 10:00 – 11:00 AM
Location: Cedarridge County Administration Building, 3rd Floor Conference Room B (the big one with the working projector!)

Attendees: Darius (organizer), Kenji Esposito, Kavya Ekwueme, Abebe Jaramillo, Sana Xu, Will Nwachukwu, Priya Xu, Facilities rep

Team, I am SO excited to finally get everyone in one room for the Sorensen contract! This is the one we've all been waiting on since the board vote, and now it's officially ours to run with.

Before we dive in, a few things:
- Please bring your notes on the scope sections you each flagged in the draft. Kavya and Abebe, I know you two read the maintenance clauses very differently, so let's hash that out together while we have Legal and Procurement at the same table.
- Kenji, if you can bring the vendor timeline printout, that would be amazing. We need to land on who owns the permitting piece before anyone reaches out to Sorensen.
- Sana and Priya, your budget breakdown is going to be the star of the show, no pressure. 😄

Parking reminder: the north lot is closed for repaving all week, so use the garage on Elm. Validate at the front desk!

Also, it's Will's birthday on Thursday!! There will be cupcakes after we wrap, and please don't tell him. (Will, if you're reading this, act surprised.)

Lunch is NOT provided since we end at 11, but the food truck is usually out front on Thursdays.

Can't wait to get this rolling with all of you. This is going to be a great one for the county!
